implementation_gate: configs/PHASE1_FROZEN_PROTOCOL.json must exist and verify before disturbance training or model selection

required_types.DisturbanceConfig: Frozen independent enable flags, parameters, severity and master seed
required_types.DisturbanceTape: Serializable, hashable, complete per-episode ordered event sequence
required_types.DisturbanceEvent: Immutable event time, type, target, intensity, payload and provenance
required_types.DisturbanceLogger: Observed application record with before/after state and effect

invariants: Every source has an independent enable flag and deterministic seed derivation
Identical config, instance seed and disturbance seed produce byte-identical tapes
Packet loss and delay affect message delivery only, never true state
Events never bypass action masks, capability constraints or predecessor constraints
All applied events record physical time, target, intensity, before, after and effect
Disabling all sources is behaviorally identical to the frozen no-disturbance baseline
Negative, saturated and impossible scenarios remain in calibration artifacts
